+        ("Application/Problem+JSON; profile=test", b'{"a":1}', [{"a": 1}]),
+        ("application/json", b"123", [123]),
+        ("application/json", b"null", [None]),
+        (
+            "application/ndjson",
+            b'\r\n \r\xef\xbb\xbf{"a":1}\r2\n[3]\r\n',
+            [{"a": 1}, 2, [3]],
+        ),
+        ("application/x-ndjson", b" \n\r", []),
+        ("application/ndjson", '"a\u2028b"\n'.encode(), ["a\u2028b"]),
+        ("application/json-seq", b' \n\x1e{"a":1}\n\x1e\n\x1e [2]\n', [{"a": 1}, [2]]),
+        ("application/json-seq", b"\x1e\x1e1", [1]),

+        ("application/json-seq", b"", []),
+        ("application/json; charset=iso-8859-1", b'["\xe9"]', ["é"]),
+    ],
+)
+async def test_json_values(media_type, payload, expected, streaming):
+    headers = {"content-type": media_type}
+    chunks = [payload[i : i + 1] for i in range(len(payload))]
+    response = httpx.Response(
+        200, headers=headers, content=iter(chunks) if streaming else payload
+    )
+    assert list(response.iter_json()) == expected
+    assert response.is_closed
+    if streaming:
+        with pytest.raises(httpx.StreamConsumed):
+            list(response.iter_json())
+    else:
+        assert list(response.iter_json()) == expected
+
+    async def body() -> typing.AsyncIterator[bytes]:
+        for chunk in chunks:
+            yield chunk
+
+    response = httpx.Response(
+        200, headers=headers, content=body() if streaming else payload
+    )
+    assert [value async for value in response.aiter_json()] == expected
+    assert response.is_closed
+    if streaming:
+        with pytest.raises(httpx.StreamConsumed):
+            [value async for value in response.aiter_json()]
+    else:
+        assert [value async for value in response.aiter_json()] == expected

+                raise DecodingError("Unexpected data after a JSON value.")
+            self.buffer = self.buffer[end:]
+            self.state = "end" if self.state == "single" else "separator"
+            yield value

+import gzip
+import typing
+
+import pytest
+
+import httpx
+
+
+class JSONStream(httpx.SyncByteStream, httpx.AsyncByteStream):
+    def __init__(self, chunks: list[bytes]) -> None:
+        self.chunks = chunks
+        self.read_count = 0
+        self.closed = False
+
+    def __iter__(self) -> typing.Iterator[bytes]:
+        for chunk in self.chunks:
+            self.read_count += 1
+            yield chunk
+
+    async def __aiter__(self) -> typing.AsyncIterator[bytes]:
+        for chunk in self:
+            yield chunk
+
+    def close(self) -> None:
+        self.closed = True
+
+    async def aclose(self) -> None:
+        self.close()
+
+
+async def collect_json(response: httpx.Response, mode: str) -> list[typing.Any]:
+    if mode == "sync":
+        return list(response.iter_json())
+    return [value async for value in response.aiter_json()]
+
+
+@pytest.mark.anyio
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("mode", ["sync", "async"])
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("chunk_size", [None, 1, 3])
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    "media_type, text, expected",
+    [
+        ("application/json", '[1, {"a": [2]}, "é", null]', [1, {"a": [2]}, "é", None]),
+        ("Application/Problem+JSON; version=1", " ﻿ [true, false] \n", [True, False]),
+        ("application/json", " 42 ", [42]),
+        ("application/json", "1.25e+3", [1250]),
+        ("application/json", "[1.25e+3, -2.5, 12]", [1250, -2.5, 12]),
+        ("application/json", ' {"key": "value"} ', [{"key": "value"}]),
+        ("application/json", "[]", []),
+        (
+            "application/ndjson",
+            '\r\n \t\r﻿{"a": 1}\r\n[2]\nnull\r3',
+            [{"a": 1}, [2], None, 3],
+        ),
+        ("APPLICATION/X-NDJSON; version=1", '"a\\nb"\n"c\\rd"', ["a\nb", "c\rd"]),
+        ("application/ndjson", " \r\n\t", []),
+        (
+            "application/json-seq",
+            '\n\x1e{"a": 1}\n\x1e\n\x1e [2] \n\x1etrue',
+            [{"a": 1}, [2], True],
+        ),
+        ("application/json-seq", "", []),
+        ("application/json-seq", " \t\r\n", []),
+        ("application/json-seq", "\x1e\x1e \n\x1e1\n\n", [1]),
+    ],
+)
+async def test_iter_json_values(mode, chunk_size, media_type, text, expected):
+    data = text.encode()
+    if chunk_size is None:
+        response = httpx.Response(
+            200, headers={"Content-Type": media_type}, content=data
+        )
+    else:
+        stream = JSONStream(
+            [data[i : i + chunk_size] for i in range(0, len(data), chunk_size)]
+        )
+        response = httpx.Response(
+            200, headers={"Content-Type": media_type}, stream=stream
+        )
+    assert await collect_json(response, mode) == expected
+    assert response.is_closed
+    if chunk_size is None:
+        assert await collect_json(response, mode) == expected
+    else:
+        assert stream.closed
+        assert response.is_stream_consumed
+        with pytest.raises(httpx.StreamConsumed):
+            await collect_json(response, mode)
+
+
+@pytest.mark.anyio
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("mode", ["sync", "async"])
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(

+)

+)
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("explicit", [False, True])
+async def test_iter_json_encoding(mode, media_type, encoding, explicit):
+    text = '\x1e"é"\n' if media_type.endswith("json-seq") else '"é"\n'
+    data = text.encode(encoding)
+    stream = JSONStream([data[i : i + 1] for i in range(len(data))])
+    content_type = media_type + (f'; charset="{encoding}"' if explicit else "")
+    response = httpx.Response(
+        200, headers={"Content-Type": content_type}, stream=stream
+    )
+    if not explicit and (
+        encoding == "latin-1"
+        or (encoding == "utf-8-sig" and media_type == "application/json-seq")
+    ):
+        with pytest.raises(httpx.DecodingError):

+        assert await collect_json(response, mode) == ["é"]

+
+
+@pytest.mark.anyio

+        ("application/json", b"\xef\xbb\xbf\xef\xbb\xbf[]"),
+        ("application/json", b"1e"),
+        ("application/json", b"[01]"),
+        ("application/json", b'"\xff"'),
+        ("application/json", b'"unterminated'),
+        ("application/json; charset=utf-16", b"[\x00"),
+        ("application/ndjson", b"1 2\n"),
+        ("application/ndjson", b"[1,\n2]\n"),
+        ("application/ndjson", b"1\n\xef\xbb\xbf2"),
+        ("application/ndjson", b" \xef\xbb\xbf1\n"),
+        ("application/ndjson", b'"a\x1eb"\n'),
+        ("application/json-seq", b"1\n"),
+        ("application/json-seq", b"\x1e"),
+        ("application/json-seq", b"\x1e\n"),
+        ("application/json-seq", b"\x1e \t\n"),
+        ("application/json-seq", b"\x1e1\n\x1e"),
+        ("application/json-seq", b"\x1e1 2\n"),
+        ("application/json-seq", b"\x1e[1,\x1e2]"),
+    ],
+)
+async def test_iter_json_errors(mode, chunk_size, media_type, data):
+    stream = JSONStream(
+        [data[i : i + chunk_size] for i in range(0, len(data), chunk_size)]
+    )
+    headers = {} if media_type is None else {"Content-Type": media_type}
+    request = httpx.Request("GET", "https://example.org")
+    response = httpx.Response(200, headers=headers, stream=stream, request=request)
+    with pytest.raises(httpx.DecodingError) as caught:
+        await collect_json(response, mode)
+    assert caught.value.request is request
+    assert response.is_closed
+    assert stream.closed
+
+
+@pytest.mark.anyio
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("mode", ["sync", "async"])
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    "media_type, first, rest",
+    [
+        ("application/json", b"[1, ", b"2]"),
+        ("application/ndjson", b"1\n  ", b"2\n"),
+        ("application/json-seq", b"\x1e1\n\x1e", b"2\n"),
+    ],
+)
+async def test_iter_json_is_incremental(mode, media_type, first, rest):
+    stream = JSONStream([first, rest])
+    response = httpx.Response(200, headers={"Content-Type": media_type}, stream=stream)
+    if mode == "sync":
+        sync_iterator = response.iter_json()
+        assert next(sync_iterator) == 1
+    else:
+        async_iterator = response.aiter_json()
+        assert await async_iterator.__anext__() == 1
+    assert stream.read_count == 1
+    assert not response.is_closed
+    if mode == "sync":
+        assert list(sync_iterator) == [2]
+    else:
+        assert [value async for value in async_iterator] == [2]
+    assert stream.closed
+
+
+@pytest.mark.anyio
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("mode", ["sync", "async"])
+async def test_iter_json_content_decoding(mode):
+    stream = JSONStream([gzip.compress(b"[1, 2]")])
+    response = httpx.Response(
+        200,
+        headers={"Content-Type": "application/json", "Content-Encoding": "gzip"},
+        stream=stream,
+    )
+    assert await collect_json(response, mode) == [1, 2]
+
+
+@pytest.mark.anyio
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("mode", ["sync", "async"])
+async def test_iter_json_close_early(mode):
+    stream = JSONStream([b"[1, ", b"2]"])
+    response = httpx.Response(
+        200, headers={"Content-Type": "application/json"}, stream=stream
+    )
+    if mode == "sync":
+        sync_iterator = response.iter_json()
+        assert next(sync_iterator) == 1
+        sync_iterator.close()
+    else:
+        async_iterator = response.aiter_json()
+        assert await async_iterator.__anext__() == 1
+        await async_iterator.aclose()
+    assert stream.closed
+    with pytest.raises(httpx.StreamConsumed):
+        await collect_json(response, mode)

+from __future__ import annotations

+import codecs
+import email.message
+import json
+import re
+import typing
+
+from ._exceptions import DecodingError
+
+_WHITESPACE = " \t\r\n"
+
+
+class JSONStreamDecoder:
+    """Decode JSON response bytes incrementally, buffering at most one value."""
+
+    def __init__(self, content_type: str) -> None:
+        message = email.message.Message()
+        message["content-type"] = content_type
+        media_type = message.get_content_type()
+        if media_type in ("application/ndjson", "application/x-ndjson"):
+            self.mode = "lines"
+        elif media_type == "application/json-seq":
+            self.mode = "sequence"
+        elif media_type == "application/json" or (
+            media_type.startswith("application/") and media_type.endswith("+json")
+        ):
+            self.mode = "document"
+        else:
+            raise DecodingError("Unsupported Content-Type for JSON iteration.")
+
+        self.decoder: codecs.IncrementalDecoder | None = None
+        charset = message.get_param("charset")
+        if charset is not None:
+            encoding = message.get_content_charset()
+            if encoding is None:
+                raise DecodingError("Invalid JSON charset.")
+            self._set_encoding(encoding)
+        self.initial = b""
+        self.document = JSONDocumentDecoder()
+        self.buffer: list[str] = []
+        self.first_line = True
+        self.in_sequence = False
+
+    def _set_encoding(self, encoding: str) -> None:
+        # Text codecs only; JSON framing owns the optional UTF-8 BOM.
+        b"".decode(encoding)
+        if self.mode != "sequence" and codecs.lookup(encoding).name == "utf-8-sig":
+            encoding = "utf-8"
+        self.decoder = codecs.getincrementaldecoder(encoding)()
+
+    def decode(self, data: bytes, final: bool = False) -> typing.Iterator[typing.Any]:
+        if self.decoder is None:
+            self.initial += data
+            # Two non-NUL ASCII bytes rule out UTF-16/32 and every BOM.
+            identifiable = (
+                len(self.initial) >= 2
+                and 0 < self.initial[0] < 128
+                and self.initial[1] != 0
+            )
+            if len(self.initial) < 4 and not identifiable and not final:
+                return
+            self._set_encoding(json.detect_encoding(self.initial))

+        assert self.decoder is not None

+            yield from self.document.decode(text, final=final)
+            return
+
+        separator = r"[\r\n]" if self.mode == "lines" else "\x1e"
+        start = 0
+        for match in re.finditer(separator, text):
+            self.buffer.append(text[start : match.start()])
+            record = "".join(self.buffer)
+            self.buffer = []
+            start = match.end()
+            yield from self._record(record, final=False)
+        self.buffer.append(text[start:])
+        if final:
+            yield from self._record("".join(self.buffer), final=True)
+            self.buffer = []
+
+    def _record(self, record: str, final: bool) -> typing.Iterator[typing.Any]:
+        if self.mode == "sequence":
+            if not self.in_sequence:
+                if record.strip(_WHITESPACE):
+                    raise DecodingError(
+                        "JSON sequence must start with a record separator."
+                    )
+                self.in_sequence = not final
+                return
+            record = record.removesuffix("\n")
+            if not record.strip() and not final:
+                return
+        else:
+            if not record.strip():
+                return
+            if self.first_line:
+                record = record.lstrip(_WHITESPACE).removeprefix("\ufeff")
+                self.first_line = False
+        yield json.loads(record)
+
+
+class JSONDocumentDecoder:
+    """Frame a JSON document or its top-level array elements before parsing."""
+
+    def __init__(self) -> None:
+        self.state = "start"
+        self.array = False
+        self.bom_seen = False
+        self.buffer: list[str] = []
+        self.depth = 0
+        self.in_string = False
+        self.escaped = False
+        self.primitive = False
+
+    def _value(self) -> typing.Any:
+        value = json.loads("".join(self.buffer))
+        self.buffer = []
+        self.state = "after" if self.array else "end"
+        return value
+
+    def decode(self, text: str, final: bool = False) -> typing.Iterator[typing.Any]:
+        for char in text:
+            if (
+                self.state == "value"
+                and self.primitive
+                and (char in _WHITESPACE or (self.array and char in ",]"))
+            ):
+                yield self._value()
+
+            if self.state != "value":
+                if char in _WHITESPACE:
+                    continue
+                if self.state == "start" and char == "\ufeff" and not self.bom_seen:
+                    self.bom_seen = True
+                    continue
+                if self.state == "start" and char == "[":
+                    self.array = True
+                    self.state = "first"
+                    continue
+                if self.state in ("first", "after") and char == "]":
+                    self.state = "end"
+                    continue
+                if self.state == "after" and char == ",":
+                    self.state = "next"
+                    continue
+                if self.state in ("after", "end"):
+                    raise DecodingError("Unexpected data after a JSON value.")
+                self.state = "value"
+                self.depth = 0
+                self.in_string = False
+                self.escaped = False
+                self.primitive = char not in '[{"'
+
+            self.buffer.append(char)
+            if self.primitive:
+                continue
+            if self.in_string:
+                if self.escaped:
+                    self.escaped = False
+                elif char == "\\":
+                    self.escaped = True
+                elif char == '"':
+                    self.in_string = False
+            elif char == '"':
+                self.in_string = True
+            elif char in "[{":
+                self.depth += 1
+            elif char in "]}":
+                self.depth -= 1
+            if not self.in_string and self.depth == 0:
+                yield self._value()
+
+        if final:
+            if self.state == "value":
+                yield self._value()
+            if self.state != "end":
+                raise DecodingError("Incomplete JSON document.")

+
+import codecs
+import email.message
+import json
+import typing
+
+from ._exceptions import DecodingError
+
+_JSON_WHITESPACE = " \t\r\n"
+
+
+class JSONDecoder:
+    """Decode JSON values incrementally, buffering at most one value or record."""
+

+        media_type = content_type.partition(";")[0].strip().lower()
+        if media_type in ("application/ndjson", "application/x-ndjson"):
+            self.mode = "ndjson"
+        elif media_type == "application/json-seq":
+            self.mode = "sequence"
+        elif media_type == "application/json" or (
+            media_type.startswith("application/") and media_type.endswith("+json")
+        ):
+            self.mode = "json"
+        else:
+            raise DecodingError(f"Unsupported JSON media type: {media_type!r}")

+        message = email.message.Message()
+        message["content-type"] = content_type
+        encoding = message.get_param("charset")

+        self.buffer: list[str] = []
+        self.state = "start"
+        self.first = True
+        self.depth = 0
+        self.in_string = False
+        self.escaped = False
+
+    def _text_decoder(self, encoding: str) -> codecs.IncrementalDecoder:
+        try:
+            if self.mode != "sequence" and codecs.lookup(encoding).name == "utf-8-sig":
+                # Framing owns BOM placement for JSON documents and NDJSON lines.
+                encoding = "utf-8"
+            decoder = codecs.getincrementaldecoder(encoding)(errors="strict")
+            if not isinstance(decoder.decode(b""), str):
+                raise DecodingError(
+                    f"JSON charset is not a text encoding: {encoding!r}"
+                )
+            return decoder
+        except (LookupError, ValueError, TypeError) as exc:
+            raise DecodingError(str(exc)) from exc
+
+    def decode(self, data: bytes, final: bool = False) -> typing.Iterator[typing.Any]:
+        if self.decoder is None:
+            self.prefix += data
+            if len(self.prefix) < 4 and not final:
+                return
+            self.decoder = self._text_decoder(json.detect_encoding(self.prefix))
+            data, self.prefix = self.prefix, b""
+        try:
+            text = self.decoder.decode(data, final=final)
+            if self.mode == "json":
+                yield from self._document(text, final)
+            else:
+                yield from self._records(text, final)
+        except ValueError as exc:
+            raise DecodingError(str(exc)) from exc
+
+    def _load(self) -> typing.Any:
+        text = "".join(self.buffer)
+        self.buffer.clear()
+        return json.loads(text)
+
+    def _document(self, text: str, final: bool) -> typing.Iterator[typing.Any]:
+        for char in text:
+            if self.state == "start":
+                if char in _JSON_WHITESPACE:
+                    continue
+                if char == "\ufeff" and self.first:
+                    self.first = False
+                    continue
+                self.state = "array" if char == "[" else "scalar"
+                if self.state == "array":
+                    self.first = True
+                    continue
+            if self.state == "done":
+                if char not in _JSON_WHITESPACE:
+                    raise DecodingError("Trailing data after JSON text")
+            elif self.state == "scalar":
+                self.buffer.append(char)
+            elif not self.in_string and self.depth == 0 and char in ",]":
+                if (
+                    char == "]"
+                    and self.first
+                    and not "".join(self.buffer).strip(_JSON_WHITESPACE)
+                ):
+                    self.buffer.clear()
+                else:
+                    yield self._load()
+                self.first = False
+                if char == "]":
+                    self.state = "done"
+            else:
+                self.buffer.append(char)
+                if self.in_string:
+                    if self.escaped:
+                        self.escaped = False
+                    elif char == "\\":
+                        self.escaped = True
+                    elif char == '"':
+                        self.in_string = False
+                elif char == '"':
+                    self.in_string = True
+                elif char in "[{":
+                    self.depth += 1
+                elif char in "]}":
+                    self.depth -= 1
+        if final:
+            if self.state == "scalar":
+                yield self._load()
+            elif self.state != "done":
+                raise DecodingError("Incomplete JSON text")
+
+    def _records(self, text: str, final: bool) -> typing.Iterator[typing.Any]:
+        for char in text:
+            if self.mode == "sequence" and self.state == "start":
+                if char in _JSON_WHITESPACE:
+                    continue
+                if char != "\x1e":
+                    raise DecodingError("JSON sequence must begin with RS")
+                self.state = "record"
+                continue
+            delimiters = "\r\n" if self.mode == "ndjson" else "\x1e"
+            if char in delimiters:
+                yield from self._record(final=False)
+            else:
+                self.buffer.append(char)
+        if final and (self.mode == "ndjson" or self.state == "record"):
+            yield from self._record(final=True)
+
+    def _record(self, final: bool) -> typing.Iterator[typing.Any]:
+        text = "".join(self.buffer)
+        self.buffer.clear()
+        if self.mode == "sequence" and text.endswith("\n"):
+            text = text[:-1]
+        text = text.strip(_JSON_WHITESPACE)
+        if not text and (self.mode == "ndjson" or not final):
+            return
+        if self.mode == "ndjson" and self.first:
+            self.first = False
+            if text.startswith("\ufeff"):
+                text = text[1:].lstrip(_JSON_WHITESPACE)
+        yield json.loads(text)

+import gzip
+import typing
+
+import pytest
+
+import httpx
+
+
+@pytest.fixture(params=["sync", "async"])
+def json_mode(request):
+    return request.param
+
+
+async def collect(response: httpx.Response, mode: str) -> typing.List[typing.Any]:
+    if mode == "sync":
+        return list(response.iter_json())
+    return [value async for value in response.aiter_json()]
+
+
+def response_for(
+    content: bytes, media_type: str, mode: str, streaming: bool = True
+) -> httpx.Response:
+    async def chunks() -> typing.AsyncIterator[bytes]:
+        for byte in content:
+            yield bytes([byte])
+
+    body = (
+        ((bytes([byte]) for byte in content) if mode == "sync" else chunks())
+        if streaming
+        else content
+    )
+    return httpx.Response(200, content=body, headers={"Content-Type": media_type})
+
+
+@pytest.mark.anyio
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("streaming", [False, True])
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    "media_type, content, expected",
+    [
+        (
+            "application/json",
+            b'[1, {"a": [true, null]}, "x\\"],", -1.2e+3]',
+            [1, {"a": [True, None]}, 'x"],', -1200],
+        ),
+        ("Application/Problem+JSON; foo=bar", b' {"a": 1} \n', [{"a": 1}]),
+        ("application/json", b" \xef\xbb\xbf [1,2] ", [1, 2]),
+        ("application/json", b"[]", []),
+        ("application/json", b"false", [False]),
+        ("application/json", b"12", [12]),
+        ("application/json", b"null", [None]),
+        (
+            "application/ndjson",
+            b'\r\n \r \xef\xbb\xbf1\r\n{"x":2}\r[3]\n',
+            [1, {"x": 2}, [3]],
+        ),
+        ("APPLICATION/X-NDJSON; charset=UTF-8", b"1\n2", [1, 2]),
+        ("application/ndjson", b" \r\n\t", []),
+        ("application/json-seq", b' \n\x1e1\n\x1e\n\x1e {"x":2}\n', [1, {"x": 2}]),
+        ("application/json-seq", b"\x1e\x1e[1,2]", [[1, 2]]),
+        ("application/json-seq", b" \r\n\t", []),
+        ("application/json-seq", b"", []),
+    ],
+)
+async def test_iter_json_values(json_mode, media_type, content, expected, streaming):
+    response = response_for(content, media_type, json_mode, streaming=streaming)
+    assert await collect(response, json_mode) == expected
+    assert response.is_closed
+    assert response.is_stream_consumed
+    if streaming:
+        with pytest.raises(httpx.StreamConsumed):
+            await collect(response, json_mode)
+        with pytest.raises(httpx.ResponseNotRead):
+            _ = response.content
+    else:
+        assert await collect(response, json_mode) == expected
+
+
+@pytest.mark.anyio
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("streaming", [False, True])
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    "media_type, content",
+    [

+        ("image/svg+json", b"1"),
+        ("", b"1"),
+        ("application/json; charset=unknown", b"1"),
+        ("application/json; charset=", b"1"),
+        ("application/json; charset=hex", b"31"),
+        ("application/json", b""),

+        ("application/json", b"[true false]"),
+        ("application/json", b"\xef\xbb\xbf\xef\xbb\xbf1"),
+        ("application/json", b'[{"x":1]]'),
+        ("application/json", b"1e"),
+        ("application/json", b'"\xff"'),
+        ("application/json", b'["\xc3'),
+        ("application/ndjson", b"1 2\n"),
+        ("application/ndjson", b"1\n\xef\xbb\xbf2"),
+        ("application/ndjson", b"\xef\xbb\xbf\n1"),
+        ("application/ndjson", b"1\x0b2"),
+        ("application/json-seq", b"1\n"),
+        ("application/json-seq", b"\x1e"),
+        ("application/json-seq", b"\x1e\n"),
+        ("application/json-seq", b"\x1e \t\n"),
+        ("application/json-seq", b"\x1e1\x1e"),
+        ("application/json-seq", b"\x1e1 2\n"),
+    ],
+)
+async def test_iter_json_invalid(json_mode, media_type, content, streaming):
+    response = response_for(content, media_type, json_mode, streaming=streaming)
+    response.request = httpx.Request("GET", "https://example.org")
+    with pytest.raises(httpx.DecodingError) as exc:
+        await collect(response, json_mode)
+    assert exc.value.request is response.request
+    assert response.is_closed
+
+
+@pytest.mark.anyio
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    "media_type", ["application/json", "application/ndjson", "application/json-seq"]
+)
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    "encoding",
+    [
+        "utf-8",
+        "utf-8-sig",
+        "utf-16",
+        "utf-16-le",
+        "utf-16-be",
+        "utf-32",
+        "utf-32-le",
+        "utf-32-be",
+        "latin-1",
+    ],
+)
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("explicit_charset", [False, True])
+async def test_iter_json_encoding(json_mode, media_type, encoding, explicit_charset):
+    if encoding == "latin-1" and not explicit_charset:
+        pytest.skip("Latin-1 requires an explicit charset")
+    text = '"é"'
+    if media_type == "application/json-seq":
+        text = "\x1e" + text + "\n"
+    if explicit_charset:
+        media_type += f'; charset="{encoding}"'
+    response = response_for(text.encode(encoding), media_type, json_mode)
+    assert await collect(response, json_mode) == ["é"]
+
+
+@pytest.mark.anyio
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    "media_type, first, last",
+    [
+        ("application/json", b"[123,", b"456]"),
+        ("application/ndjson", b"123\n", b"456\n"),
+        ("application/json-seq", b"\x1e123\n\x1e", b"456\n"),
+    ],
+)
+async def test_iter_json_incremental(json_mode, media_type, first, last):
+    advanced = False
+
+    def chunks() -> typing.Iterator[bytes]:
+        nonlocal advanced
+        yield first
+        advanced = True
+        yield last
+
+    async def achunks() -> typing.AsyncIterator[bytes]:
+        for chunk in chunks():
+            yield chunk
+
+    response = httpx.Response(
+        200,
+        content=chunks() if json_mode == "sync" else achunks(),
+        headers={"Content-Type": media_type},
+    )
+    if json_mode == "sync":
+        iterator = response.iter_json()
+        assert next(iterator) == 123
+        assert not advanced
+        assert list(iterator) == [456]
+    else:
+        async_iterator = response.aiter_json()
+        assert await async_iterator.__anext__() == 123
+        assert not advanced
+        assert [value async for value in async_iterator] == [456]
+    assert response.is_closed
+
+
+@pytest.mark.anyio
+async def test_iter_json_compressed(json_mode):
+    response = response_for(gzip.compress(b"[1,2]"), "application/json", json_mode)
+    response.headers["Content-Encoding"] = "gzip"
+    assert await collect(response, json_mode) == [1, 2]
+
+
+@pytest.mark.anyio
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("ending", ["complete", "invalid", "close"])
+async def test_iter_json_closes_stream(json_mode, ending):
+    class Stream(httpx.SyncByteStream, httpx.AsyncByteStream):
+        closed = False
+        finalized = False
+
+        def __iter__(self):
+            yield b"[123,"
+            yield b"456]" if ending != "invalid" else b"!]"
+
+        async def __aiter__(self):
+            try:
+                for chunk in self:
+                    yield chunk
+            finally:
+                self.finalized = True
+
+        def close(self):
+            self.closed = True
+
+        async def aclose(self):
+            self.closed = True
+
+    stream = Stream()
+    response = httpx.Response(
+        200, stream=stream, headers={"Content-Type": "application/json"}
+    )
+    if ending == "invalid":
+        with pytest.raises(httpx.DecodingError):
+            await collect(response, json_mode)
+    elif ending == "complete":
+        assert await collect(response, json_mode) == [123, 456]
+    elif json_mode == "sync":
+        iterator = response.iter_json()
+        assert next(iterator) == 123
+        iterator.close()
+    else:
+        async_iterator = response.aiter_json()
+        assert await async_iterator.__anext__() == 123
+        await async_iterator.aclose()
+    assert stream.closed
+    assert response.is_closed
+    if json_mode == "async":
+        assert stream.finalized
+    with pytest.raises(httpx.StreamConsumed):
+        await collect(response, json_mode)

+                "application/x-ndjson",

+                if not self.buffer:

+                    self.state = "array_value"

+                else:

+            if self.state == "end":
+                if self.buffer:
+                    raise ValueError("Trailing data after JSON document.")
+                return
+        if final:
+            raise ValueError("Incomplete JSON document.")

@@ -366,6 +366,20 @@ Or stream the text, on a line-by-line basis...
 
 HTTPX will use universal line endings, normalising all cases to `\n`.
 
+You can also stream parsed JSON values:
+
+```python
+with httpx.stream("GET", "https://www.example.com/data.json") as response:
+    for value in response.iter_json():
+        print(value)
+```
+
+For `application/json` and `application/*+json`, `iter_json()` yields each element of a top-level array, or the single value otherwise. For `application/ndjson`, `application/x-ndjson`, and `application/json-seq`, it yields each record without expanding arrays inside records. Async responses provide the same behavior through `aiter_json()`.
+
+Media types are case-insensitive and can include parameters. An explicit `charset` must name a valid codec; otherwise HTTPX detects UTF-8, UTF-16, or UTF-32. Invalid media types, encodings, JSON, or trailing data raise `httpx.DecodingError`. Errors can occur after earlier values have been yielded.
+
+JSON iteration consumes and closes streaming responses without buffering the body. A second iteration raises `httpx.StreamConsumed`. Responses whose content is already in memory can be iterated again. If you stop early, close the iterator or use the response stream context manager to release the connection.
+
 In some cases you might want to access the raw bytes on the response without applying any HTTP content decoding. In this case any content encoding that the web server has applied such as `gzip`, `deflate`, `brotli`, or `zstd` will
 not be automatically decoded.

+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import codecs
+import email.message
+import json
+import re
+import typing
+
+from ._exceptions import DecodingError
+
+_WHITESPACE = " \t\r\n"
+
+
+class JSONStreamDecoder:
+    """Decode JSON response bytes, retaining only the unfinished value or record."""
+
+    def __init__(self, content_type: str) -> None:
+        media_type = content_type.partition(";")[0].strip().lower()
+        if media_type in ("application/ndjson", "application/x-ndjson"):
+            self.mode = "lines"
+        elif media_type == "application/json-seq":
+            self.mode = "sequence"
+        elif media_type == "application/json" or (
+            media_type.startswith("application/") and media_type.endswith("+json")
+        ):
+            self.mode = "json"
+        else:
+            raise DecodingError("Unsupported JSON Content-Type")
+
+        message = email.message.Message()
+        message["content-type"] = content_type
+        encoding = message.get_content_charset()
+        if encoding is None and message.get_param("charset") is not None:
+            raise DecodingError("Invalid JSON charset")
+        self.decoder = None
+        if encoding is not None:
+            try:
+                encoding = codecs.lookup(encoding).name
+                if encoding == "utf-8-sig" and self.mode != "sequence":
+                    encoding = "utf-8"
+                self.decoder = codecs.getincrementaldecoder(encoding)(errors="strict")
+            except LookupError as exc:
+                raise DecodingError(str(exc)) from exc
+        self.prefix = b""
+        self.buffer = ""
+        self.state = "start"
+        self.first_line = True
+        self.json_decoder = json.JSONDecoder()
+
+    def decode(self, data: bytes, final: bool = False) -> typing.Iterator[typing.Any]:
+        try:
+            if self.decoder is None:
+                self.prefix += data
+                # An ASCII byte followed by a nonzero byte rules out UTF-16/32
+                # and every BOM, so short records need not wait for four bytes.
+                utf8 = (
+                    len(self.prefix) >= 2
+                    and 0 < self.prefix[0] < 128
+                    and self.prefix[1] != 0
+                )
+                if len(self.prefix) < 4 and not utf8 and not final:
+                    return
+                encoding = json.detect_encoding(self.prefix)
+                if encoding == "utf-8-sig" and self.mode != "sequence":
+                    encoding = "utf-8"
+                self.decoder = codecs.getincrementaldecoder(encoding)(errors="strict")
+                data, self.prefix = self.prefix, b""
+            self.buffer += self.decoder.decode(data, final=final)
+            if self.mode == "json":
+                yield from self._values(final)
+            else:
+                yield from self._records(final)
+        except (ValueError, TypeError) as exc:
+            raise DecodingError(str(exc)) from exc
+
+    def _records(self, final: bool) -> typing.Iterator[typing.Any]:
+        if self.mode == "sequence" and self.state == "start":
+            self.buffer = self.buffer.lstrip(_WHITESPACE)
+            if not self.buffer:
+                return
+            if self.buffer[0] != "\x1e":
+                raise DecodingError("JSON sequence must begin with RS")
+            self.buffer = self.buffer[1:]
+            self.state = "record"
+
+        separator = r"[\r\n]" if self.mode == "lines" else "\x1e"
+        while True:
+            match = re.search(separator, self.buffer)
+            if match is None and not final:
+                return
+            if match is None:
+                record, self.buffer = self.buffer, ""
+            else:
+                record, self.buffer = (
+                    self.buffer[: match.start()],
+                    self.buffer[match.end() :],
+                )
+            if self.mode == "sequence" and record.endswith("\n"):
+                record = record[:-1]
+            record = record.strip(_WHITESPACE)
+            if record:
+                if self.mode == "lines" and self.first_line:
+                    record = record.removeprefix("\ufeff").lstrip(_WHITESPACE)
+                    self.first_line = False
+                yield json.loads(record)
+            elif self.mode == "sequence" and match is None:
+                raise DecodingError("Final JSON sequence record is empty")
+            if match is None:

+from __future__ import annotations

+import gzip

+@pytest.mark.parametrize("async_mode", [False, True])
+@pytest.mark.anyio
+async def test_iter_json_incremental(async_mode):
+    chunks = iter([b"[1, ", b'{"nested": [true, null]}, ', b'"end"]'])
+
+    async def async_chunks() -> typing.AsyncIterator[bytes]:
+        for chunk in chunks:
+            yield chunk
+
+    response = httpx.Response(
+        200,
+        headers={"content-type": "application/json"},
+        content=async_chunks() if async_mode else chunks,
+    )
+    if async_mode:
+        async_values = response.aiter_json()
+        assert await async_values.__anext__() == 1
+        assert not response.is_closed
+        assert [value async for value in async_values] == [
+            {"nested": [True, None]},
+            "end",
+        ]
+        with pytest.raises(httpx.StreamConsumed):
+            await response.aiter_json().__anext__()
+    else:
+        values = response.iter_json()
+        assert next(values) == 1
+        assert not response.is_closed
+        assert list(values) == [{"nested": [True, None]}, "end"]
+        with pytest.raises(httpx.StreamConsumed):
+            next(response.iter_json())
+    assert response.is_closed
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("async_mode", [False, True])

+        closed = False

+        def __iter__(self) -> typing.Iterator[bytes]:
+            try:

+;; Environments contain mutable frames. Closures retain frames, not snapshots,
+;; so definitions and set! remain visible through recursive and sibling calls.
+(define (make-environment parent)
+  (cons '() parent))
+
+(define (find-binding name bindings)
+  (cond ((null? bindings) #f)
+        ((eq? name (car (car bindings))) (car bindings))
+        (else (find-binding name (cdr bindings)))))
+
+(define (lookup-binding name env)
+  (let ((binding (find-binding name (car env))))
+    (if binding
+        binding
+        (lookup-binding name (cdr env)))))
+
+(define (bind! name value env)
+  (let ((binding (find-binding name (car env))))
+    (if binding
+        (set-cdr! binding value)
+        (set-car! env (cons (cons name value) (car env))))))
+
+(define (bind-parameters! params args env)
+  (if (null? params)
+      '()
+      (begin
+        (bind! (car params) (car args) env)
+        (bind-parameters! (cdr params) (cdr args) env))))
+
+(define (evaluate-sequence body env)
+  (if (null? body)
+      '()
+      (let ((value (evaluate (car body) env)))
+        (if (null? (cdr body))
+            value
+            (evaluate-sequence (cdr body) env)))))

+;; Every interpreted procedure is a host closure accepting one argument list.
+;; This also lets primitive and user procedures share the application path.
+(define (make-procedure params body env)
+  (lambda (args)
+    (let ((local (make-environment env)))
+      (bind-parameters! params args local)
+      (evaluate-sequence body local))))

+(define (evaluate-arguments exprs env)
+  (if (null? exprs)

+            (evaluate-arguments (cdr exprs) env))))

+(define (evaluate-bindings! bindings outer local)

+        (bind! (car (car bindings))
+               (evaluate (car (cdr (car bindings))) outer)
+               local)
+        (evaluate-bindings! (cdr bindings) outer local))))

+            (evaluate-sequence (cdr clause) env)

@@ -0,0 +1,55 @@
+"""Compare the evaluator with the public Python interpreter entry point."""
+import pathlib
+import subprocess
+import sys
+import tempfile
+import unittest
+
+ROOT = pathlib.Path(__file__).resolve().parent
+
+
+def run(program, data):
+    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as directory:
+        result = subprocess.run(
+            [sys.executable, str(ROOT / "interp.py"), str(program)],
+            input=data, text=True, capture_output=True, cwd=directory, timeout=120,
+        )
+    if result.returncode:
+        raise AssertionError(result.stderr)
+    return result.stdout
+
+
+class EvaluatorTest(unittest.TestCase):
+    def test_calculator_at_two_levels(self):
+        program = ROOT / "test/calculator.scm"
+        data = "(+ 7 8)\n"
+        expected = run(program, data)
+        self.assertEqual(expected, "Reading\n15\nDone\n")
+        for depth in (1, 2):
+            with self.subTest(depth=depth):
+                paths = (str(ROOT / "eval.scm") + "\n") * (depth - 1) + str(program) + "\n"
+                self.assertEqual(run(ROOT / "eval.scm", paths + data), expected)
+
+    def test_source_expression_boundaries(self):
+        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as directory:
+            program = pathlib.Path(directory) / "source with spaces.scm"
+            program.write_text(
+                "() (define x 7) (display x) ; ignored ) (\n"
+                "(display \"a;('b\") (newline)\n"
+                "' () (display '(one two)) (newline)\n"
+                "(display (+ 1\n 2)) (newline)\n"
+            )
+            expected = run(program, "")
+            self.assertEqual(expected, "7a;('b\n('one' 'two')\n3\n")
+            self.assertEqual(run(ROOT / "eval.scm", str(program) + "\n"), expected)
+
+    def test_repository_programs(self):
+        for program in sorted((ROOT / "test").glob("*.scm")):
+            with self.subTest(program=program.name):
+                data = "7\n8\n+\n" if program.name == "06-interactive-io.scm" else "(+ 7 8)\n"
+                expected = run(program, data)
+                self.assertEqual(run(ROOT / "eval.scm", str(program) + "\n" + data), expected)
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    unittest.main()

+  (if (null? bindings)
+      #f
+      (if (eq? name (car (car bindings)))

+          (ev-find name (cdr bindings)))))
+

+  (let ((cell (ev-find name (car env))))
+    (if cell cell (ev-cell name (cdr env)))))
+
+(define (ev-define name value env)
+  (let ((cell (ev-find name (car env))))
+    (if cell
+        (set-cdr! cell value)
+        (set-car! env (cons (cons name value) (car env))))))
+
+(define (ev-bind names values env)
+  (if (null? names)
+      env
+      (begin
+        (ev-define (car names) (car values) env)
+        (ev-bind (cdr names) (cdr values) env))))
+

+  (if (null? body)
+      '()
+      (let ((value (ev (car body) env)))
+        (if (null? (cdr body)) value (ev-sequence (cdr body) env)))))
+

+  (lambda (args)
+    (ev-sequence body (ev-bind params args (cons '() env)))))

+            (ev-arguments (cdr expressions) env))))

+        (ev-let (cdr bindings) outer inner))))

+      '()
+      (let ((clause (car clauses)))

+            (ev-sequence (cdr clause) env)
+            (ev-cond (cdr clauses) env)))))
+

+  (cond
+    ((symbol? expression) (cdr (ev-cell expression env)))
+    ((not (pair? expression)) expression)
+    (else
+      (let ((op (car expression)) (args (cdr expression)))
+        (cond
+          ((eq? op 'quote) (car args))

+          ((eq? op 'let)

+          ((eq? op 'begin) (ev-sequence args env))
+          ((eq? op 'progn) (ev-sequence args env))
+          ((eq? op 'cond) (ev-cond args env))

+
+(define (ev-unary f)
+  (lambda (args) (f (car args))))
+
+(define (ev-binary f)
+  (lambda (args) (f (car args) (car (cdr args)))))
+
+(define (ev-nullary f)
+  (lambda (args) (f)))
+

+(ev-install '> (ev-binary >))
+(ev-install '<= (ev-binary <=))
+(ev-install '>= (ev-binary >=))
+(ev-install 'cons (ev-binary cons))
+(ev-install 'car (ev-unary car))
+(ev-install 'cdr (ev-unary cdr))
+(ev-install 'null? (ev-unary null?))
+(ev-install 'pair? (ev-unary pair?))
+(ev-install 'eq? (ev-binary eq?))
+(ev-install 'equal? (ev-binary equal?))
+(ev-install 'not (ev-unary not))

+(ev-install 'or (lambda (args) (ev-fold or #f args)))

+(ev-install 'putchr (ev-unary putchr))
+(ev-install 'chr (ev-unary chr))
+(ev-install 'read (ev-nullary read))
+(ev-install 'symbol (ev-unary symbol))
+(ev-install 'symbol? (ev-unary symbol?))
+(ev-install 'string? (ev-unary string?))
+(ev-install 'number? (ev-unary number?))

+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import codecs
+import email.message
+import json
+import re
+import typing
+
+from ._exceptions import DecodingError
+
+_WHITESPACE = " \t\r\n"
+
+
+class JSONStreamDecoder:
+    """Decode JSON bytes incrementally, retaining only the current value or record."""
+
+    def __init__(self, content_type: str) -> None:
+        media_type = content_type.partition(";")[0].strip().lower()
+        if media_type in ("application/ndjson", "application/x-ndjson"):
+            self.format = "ndjson"
+        elif media_type == "application/json-seq":
+            self.format = "sequence"
+        elif media_type == "application/json" or (
+            media_type.startswith("application/")
+            and media_type.endswith("+json")
+            and len(media_type) > len("application/+json")
+        ):
+            self.format = "json"
+        else:
+            raise DecodingError("Unsupported JSON Content-Type.")
+
+        # Match the charset parsing used by Response without its UTF-8 fallback.
+        message = email.message.Message()
+        message["content-type"] = content_type
+        self.encoding = message.get_content_charset()
+        self.text_decoder = None
+        if self.encoding is not None:
+            try:
+                codec = codecs.lookup(self.encoding)
+                if not codec._is_text_encoding:
+                    raise DecodingError("The JSON charset is not a text encoding.")
+                if codec.name == "utf-8-sig" and self.format != "sequence":
+                    self.encoding = "utf-8"
+                self.text_decoder = codecs.getincrementaldecoder(self.encoding)(
+                    errors="strict"
+                )
+            except (LookupError, ValueError) as exc:
+                raise DecodingError(str(exc)) from exc
+        self.prefix = b""
+        self.buffer = ""
+        self.state = "start"
+        self.first_line = True
+        self.json_decoder = json.JSONDecoder()
+
+    def decode(
+        self, data: bytes, *, final: bool = False
+    ) -> typing.Iterator[typing.Any]:
+        try:
+            if self.text_decoder is None:
+                self.prefix += data
+                unambiguous_utf8 = (
+                    len(self.prefix) >= 2
+                    and b"\x00" not in self.prefix[:2]
+                    and not self.prefix.startswith((b"\xef", b"\xff", b"\xfe"))
+                )
+                if len(self.prefix) < 4 and not unambiguous_utf8 and not final:
+                    return
+                encoding = json.detect_encoding(self.prefix)
+                if encoding == "utf-8-sig" and self.format != "sequence":
+                    encoding = "utf-8"
+                self.text_decoder = codecs.getincrementaldecoder(encoding)(
+                    errors="strict"
+                )
+                data, self.prefix = self.prefix, b""
+            text = self.text_decoder.decode(data, final=final)
+            if self.format == "ndjson" and self.state == "start" and text:
+                self.state = "lines"
+                if text.startswith("\ufeff"):
+                    text = text[1:]
+                    self.first_line = False
+            self.buffer += text
+            if self.format == "json":
+                yield from self._document(final)
+            elif self.format == "ndjson":
+                yield from self._lines(final)
+            else:
+                yield from self._sequence(final)
+        except ValueError as exc:
+            raise DecodingError(str(exc)) from exc
+
+    def _document(self, final: bool) -> typing.Iterator[typing.Any]:
+        while True:
+            self.buffer = self.buffer.lstrip(_WHITESPACE)
+            if self.state == "start":
+                if not self.buffer:

+        while True:

+            if match is None:

+                    self.first_line = False
+                yield json.loads(line)
+            if match is None:

+
+    def _sequence(self, final: bool) -> typing.Iterator[typing.Any]:
+        if self.state == "start":
+            self.buffer = self.buffer.lstrip(_WHITESPACE)
+            if not self.buffer:
+                return
+            if not self.buffer.startswith("\x1e"):

+                record, self.buffer = self.buffer, ""
+            else:
+                record, self.buffer = self.buffer[:end], self.buffer[end + 1 :]
+            record = record.removesuffix("\n").strip(_WHITESPACE)
+            if record or end == -1:
+                yield json.loads(record)
+            if end == -1:
+                return

+import typing
+

+
+import httpx
+

+@pytest.fixture(params=["sync", "async"])
+def mode(request):
+    return request.param
+
+
+def make_response(
+    payload: bytes, content_type: str | None, mode: str, chunk_size: int | None = None
+) -> httpx.Response:
+    headers = {} if content_type is None else {"Content-Type": content_type}
+    if chunk_size is None:
+        return httpx.Response(200, content=payload, headers=headers)
+
+    def chunks() -> typing.Iterator[bytes]:
+        for index in range(0, len(payload), chunk_size):
+            yield payload[index : index + chunk_size]
+
+    async def achunks() -> typing.AsyncIterator[bytes]:
+        for chunk in chunks():
+            yield chunk
+
+    content = chunks() if mode == "sync" else achunks()
+    return httpx.Response(200, content=content, headers=headers)
+
+
+async def collect(response: httpx.Response, mode: str) -> list[typing.Any]:
+    if mode == "sync":
+        return list(response.iter_json())
+    return [value async for value in response.aiter_json()]

+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import codecs
+import email.message
+import json
+import re
+import typing
+
+from ._exceptions import DecodingError
+
+_WHITESPACE = " \t\r\n"
+
+
+class JSONStreamDecoder:
+    """Decode JSON values while retaining only the unfinished text or record."""
+
+    def __init__(self, content_type: str) -> None:
+        message = email.message.Message()
+        message["content-type"] = content_type
+        media_type = content_type.partition(";")[0].strip().lower()
+        if media_type in ("application/ndjson", "application/x-ndjson"):
+            self.mode = "lines"
+        elif media_type == "application/json-seq":
+            self.mode = "sequence"
+        elif media_type == "application/json" or (
+            media_type.startswith("application/") and media_type.endswith("+json")
+        ):
+            self.mode = "document"
+        else:
+            raise DecodingError("Unsupported JSON Content-Type.")
+        self.encoding = message.get_content_charset()
+        self.decoder: codecs.IncrementalDecoder | None = None
+        if message.get_param("charset") is not None:
+            if self.encoding is None:
+                raise DecodingError("Invalid JSON charset.")
+            try:
+                self.decoder = self._text_decoder(self.encoding)
+            except (LookupError, TypeError) as exc:
+                raise DecodingError("Invalid JSON charset.") from exc
+        self.prefix = b""
+        self.buffer = ""
+        self.state = "start"
+        self.first_line = True
+        self.json_decoder = json.JSONDecoder()
+
+    def _text_decoder(self, encoding: str) -> codecs.IncrementalDecoder:
+        # Documents and lines own BOM handling, including BOMs after whitespace.
+        if self.mode != "sequence" and codecs.lookup(encoding).name == "utf-8-sig":
+            encoding = "utf-8"
+        return codecs.getincrementaldecoder(encoding)("strict")
+
+    def decode(self, data: bytes, final: bool = False) -> typing.Iterator[typing.Any]:
+        try:
+            if self.decoder is None:
+                self.prefix += data
+                # Four bytes distinguish UTF-8, UTF-16, and UTF-32, even when
+                # their BOM or first code point spans transport chunks.
+                utf8_prefix = (
+                    len(self.prefix) >= 2
+                    and 0 not in self.prefix[:2]
+                    and self.prefix[:2] not in (b"\xef\xbb", b"\xff\xfe", b"\xfe\xff")
+                )
+                if len(self.prefix) < 4 and not utf8_prefix and not final:
+                    return
+                self.decoder = self._text_decoder(json.detect_encoding(self.prefix))
+                data, self.prefix = self.prefix, b""
+            self.buffer += self.decoder.decode(data, final=final)
+            if self.mode == "document":
+                yield from self._document(final)
+            else:
+                yield from self._records(final)
+        except (ValueError, TypeError) as exc:
+            raise DecodingError(str(exc)) from exc
+
+    def _document(self, final: bool) -> typing.Iterator[typing.Any]:
+        while True:
+            self.buffer = self.buffer.lstrip(_WHITESPACE)
+            if self.state == "start":
+                if not self.buffer and not final:
+                    return
+                if self.buffer.startswith("\ufeff"):
+                    self.buffer = self.buffer[1:]
+                self.state = "root"
+                continue
+            if self.state == "root" and self.buffer.startswith("["):
+                self.buffer = self.buffer[1:]
+                self.state = "array_first"
+                continue
+            if self.state == "done":
+                if self.buffer:
+                    raise DecodingError("Trailing data after JSON text.")
+                return
+            if self.state in ("array_first", "array_separator"):
+                if self.buffer.startswith("]"):
+                    self.buffer = self.buffer[1:]
+                    self.state = "done"
+                    continue
+                if self.state == "array_separator":
+                    if self.buffer.startswith(","):
+                        self.buffer = self.buffer[1:]
+                        self.state = "array_value"
+                        continue
+                    if not self.buffer and not final:
+                        return
+                    raise DecodingError("Expected ',' or ']' in JSON array.")
+            try:
+                value, end = self.json_decoder.raw_decode(self.buffer)
+            except ValueError:
+                if not final:
+                    return
+                raise
+            # raw_decode accepts a numeric prefix, including '1' in '1e2'.
+            # A number is complete only at a delimiter or at end of stream.
+            if isinstance(value, (int, float)) and not isinstance(value, bool):
+                if not final and (
+                    end == len(self.buffer)
+                    or self.buffer[end] not in _WHITESPACE + ",]"
+                ):

+_WHITESPACE = " \t\r\n"

+class JSONDecoder:
+    """Incrementally decode JSON bytes, retaining only the current value or record."""
+
+    def __init__(self, content_type: str) -> None:
+        media_type = content_type.partition(";")[0].strip().lower()
+        if media_type in ("application/ndjson", "application/x-ndjson"):
+            self.format = "ndjson"
+        elif media_type == "application/json-seq":
+            self.format = "seq"
+        elif media_type == "application/json" or (

+                raise DecodingError("Invalid JSON charset")

+                b"".decode(encoding)

+                    encoding = "utf-8"
+                self.decoder = codecs.getincrementaldecoder(encoding)(errors="strict")
+            except (LookupError, ValueError) as exc:
+                raise DecodingError(str(exc)) from exc
+
+        self.prefix = b""
+        self.buffer: list[str] = []
+        self.first_record = True
+        self.sequence_started = False
+        self.state = "start"
+        self.array = False
+        self.bom_seen = False
+        self.depth = 0
+        self.in_string = False
+        self.escaped = False
+        self.scalar = False
+
+    def decode(self, data: bytes, final: bool = False) -> typing.Iterator[typing.Any]:
+        try:
+            if self.decoder is None:
+                self.prefix += data
+                # Two non-null bytes starting with ASCII rule out UTF-16/32.
+                utf8 = (
+                    len(self.prefix) >= 2
+                    and 0 < self.prefix[0] < 128
+                    and self.prefix[1] != 0
+                )

+                    return
+                encoding = json.detect_encoding(self.prefix)
+                if encoding == "utf-8-sig" and self.format != "seq":
+                    encoding = "utf-8"

+            else:

+        yield from self.decode(b"", final=True)
+

+        if self.format == "ndjson":
+            parts = re.split("[\r\n]", text)
+        else:
+            parts = text.split("\x1e")

+                if parts.pop(0).strip(_WHITESPACE):
+                    raise DecodingError("JSON sequence must start with RS")
+                if not parts:

+                self.sequence_started = True
+
+        for part in parts[:-1]:
+            self.buffer.append(part)
+            yield from self._record(final=False)
+        self.buffer.append(parts[-1])
+        if final:
+            yield from self._record(final=True)
+
+    def _record(self, final: bool) -> typing.Iterator[typing.Any]:
+        text = "".join(self.buffer)
+        self.buffer.clear()
+        if self.format == "seq":
+            if text.endswith("\n"):
+                text = text[:-1]

+                return

+    def _decode_json(self, text: str, final: bool) -> typing.Iterator[typing.Any]:

+                    self.bom_seen = True

+                if char == "[":

+                    continue
+                self.state = "value"

+            if self.state in ("first", "element"):
+                if char in _WHITESPACE:
+                    continue
+                if char == "]" and self.state == "first":
+                    self.state = "end"
+                    continue

+            if self.state == "value":
+                if not self.buffer:
+                    self.scalar = char not in '[{"'
+                    self.depth = 0
+                    self.in_string = False
+                    self.escaped = False
+                elif self.scalar and char in _WHITESPACE + ",]":
+                    # Numbers need a delimiter: a later chunk may extend an exponent.
+                    yield self._finish_value()
+
+                if self.state == "value":
+                    self.buffer.append(char)
+                    if not self.scalar:
+                        if self.in_string:
+                            if self.escaped:
+                                self.escaped = False
+                            elif char == "\\":
+                                self.escaped = True
+                            elif char == '"':
+                                self.in_string = False
+                        elif char == '"':
+                            self.in_string = True
+                        elif char in "[{":
+                            self.depth += 1
+                        elif char in "]}":
+                            self.depth -= 1
+                        if not self.in_string and self.depth == 0:
+                            yield self._finish_value()

+            if self.state == "delimiter":
+                if char in _WHITESPACE:
+                    continue
+                if char == ",":
+                    self.state = "element"
+                    continue
+                if char == "]":
+                    self.state = "end"
+                    continue

+
+            if self.state == "end" and char not in _WHITESPACE:
+                raise DecodingError("Trailing data after JSON text")
+
+        if final:
+            if self.state == "value":
+                yield self._finish_value()
+            if self.state != "end":
+                raise DecodingError("Incomplete or empty JSON text")

+class JSONDecoder:
+    """Incrementally decode JSON documents, NDJSON, or JSON text sequences."""
+
+    def __init__(self, content_type: str) -> None:
+        media_type = content_type.partition(";")[0].strip().lower()
+        if media_type in ("application/ndjson", "application/x-ndjson"):
+            self.mode = "lines"
+        elif media_type == "application/json-seq":
+            self.mode = "sequence"
+        elif media_type == "application/json" or (
+            media_type.startswith("application/") and media_type.endswith("+json")
+        ):

+        else:
+            raise DecodingError("Content-Type does not identify a JSON stream.")
+
+        message = email.message.Message()
+        message["content-type"] = content_type
+        self.bom_allowed = True
+        self.decoder: codecs.IncrementalDecoder | None = None
+        if message.get_param("charset") is not None:
+            encoding = message.get_content_charset()
+            if encoding is None:
+                raise DecodingError("Invalid JSON charset.")
+            self.decoder = self._text_decoder(encoding)
+        self.prefix = bytearray()
+        self.buffer: list[str] = []
+        self.state = "start"
+        self.first_line = True
+        self.empty_array = True
+        self.depth = 0
+        self.in_string = False
+        self.escaped = False
+
+    def _text_decoder(self, encoding: str) -> codecs.IncrementalDecoder:
+        try:
+            if codecs.lookup(encoding).name == "utf-8-sig":
+                encoding = "utf-8"
+            decoder = codecs.getincrementaldecoder(encoding)(errors="strict")
+            if not isinstance(decoder.decode(b""), str):
+                raise DecodingError("JSON charset must decode bytes into text.")
+            return decoder
+        except (LookupError, TypeError, ValueError) as exc:
+            raise DecodingError(str(exc)) from exc
+
+    def _decode_text(self, data: bytes, final: bool = False) -> str:
+        if self.decoder is None:
+            self.prefix.extend(data)
+            # Four bytes distinguish UTF-8, UTF-16, and UTF-32, even across chunks.
+            if len(self.prefix) < 4 and not final:
+                return ""
+            data = bytes(self.prefix)
+            self.prefix.clear()
+            self.decoder = self._text_decoder(json.detect_encoding(data))
+        try:
+            return self.decoder.decode(data, final=final)
+        except ValueError as exc:
+            raise DecodingError(str(exc)) from exc

+    def decode(self, data: bytes) -> typing.Iterator[typing.Any]:
+        yield from self._parse_text(self._decode_text(data))
+
+    def flush(self) -> typing.Iterator[typing.Any]:
+        yield from self._parse_text(self._decode_text(b"", final=True))
+        if self.mode == "document":

+                if self.state != "single":
+                    raise DecodingError("Incomplete JSON document.")
+                yield self._load("".join(self.buffer))
+        elif self.mode == "lines":

+        elif self.state == "start":
+            if "".join(self.buffer).strip(_JSON_WHITESPACE):

+            elif char in "]}":
+                self.depth -= 1

+            self.buffer.append(text[start:])

+"""Compare the evaluator with the real interp.py command-line entry point."""
+import pathlib
+import subprocess
+import sys
+import tempfile
+import unittest
+
+ROOT = pathlib.Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
+
+
+def run(path, data):
+    result = subprocess.run(
+        [sys.executable, str(ROOT / "interp.py"), str(path)],
+        input=data, text=True, capture_output=True, cwd=ROOT, timeout=120,
+    )
+    if result.returncode or result.stderr:
+        raise AssertionError((result.returncode, result.stdout, result.stderr))
+    return result.stdout
+
+
+class EvaluatorTest(unittest.TestCase):
+    def test_programs(self):
+        inputs = {
+            "calculator.scm": "(+ 7 8)\n",
+            "06-interactive-io.scm": "7\n8\n+\n",
+            "test_read.scm": "(a 1 (b 2))\n",
+        }
+        for path in sorted((ROOT / "test").glob("*.scm")):
+            with self.subTest(program=path.name):
+                data = inputs.get(path.name, "")
+                expected = run(path, data)
+                self.assertNotIn("Error:", expected)
+                self.assertNotIn("Unexpected error:", expected)
+                self.assertEqual(run("eval.scm", f"{path}\n{data}"), expected)
+
+    def test_self_interpretation(self):
+        data = "(+ 7 8)\n"
+        expected = "Reading\n15\nDone\n"
+        self.assertEqual(run("test/calculator.scm", data), expected)
+        self.assertEqual(run("eval.scm", "eval.scm\ntest/calculator.scm\n" + data), expected)
+
+    def test_source_layout_and_remaining_input(self):
+        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as directory:
+            path = pathlib.Path(directory) / "program with spaces.scm"
+            path.write_text(
+                "() (define x 7) (display (+ x 8)) (newline)\n"
+                "(display \"a; (quoted) string\") (newline)\n"
+                "(display (getchr)) (display (read)) ; final comment",
+                encoding="utf-8",
+            )
+            data = "Z(1 2)\n"
+            self.assertEqual(run("eval.scm", f"{path}\n{data}"), run(path, data))
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    unittest.main()

+    (unary 'car car)
+    (unary 'cdr cdr)

+    (unary 'pair? pair?)

+    (binary 'equal? equal?)

+    (unary 'putchr putchr)
+    (unary 'chr chr)
+    (nullary 'read read)
+    (unary 'symbol symbol)
+    (unary 'symbol? symbol?)
+    (unary 'string? string?)
+    (unary 'number? number?)

+    (binary 'set-cdr! set-cdr!)

+    (unary 'fclose fclose)
+    (unary 'fgetchr fgetchr)
+    (binary 'fputchr fputchr)
+    (binary 'fdisplay fdisplay)
+    (unary 'fread fread)
+    env))

+  (let ((character (getchr)))

+        (symbol (ev-reverse reversed '()))
+        (ev-path (cons character reversed)))))
+
+(define (ev-reverse input output)
+  (if (null? input)
+      output
+      (ev-reverse (cdr input) (cons (car input) output))))
+

+; for an empty form and EOF. A character cursor supplies form boundaries. The
+; parsing port is reopened only when another form shares the preceding line.

+(define ev-source (fopen ev-name "r"))
+(define ev-parser (fopen ev-name "r"))

+(define ev-offset 0)
+(define ev-line 0)
+(define ev-parser-line 0)

+  (if (= ev-character 10) (set! ev-line (+ ev-line 1)))
+  (set! ev-offset (+ ev-offset 1))
+  (set! ev-character (fgetchr ev-source)))

+

+  (if (or (= ev-character -1) (= ev-character 10))

+      (begin (ev-next) (ev-comment))))

+  (cond ((ev-space? ev-character) (ev-next) (ev-skip))
+        ((= ev-character 59) (ev-comment) (ev-skip))))

+(define ev-depth 0)
+(define ev-string #f)
+(define ev-escape #f)
+(define ev-in-comment #f)
+(define ev-done #f)

+  (cond
+    ((= ev-character -1) (set! ev-done #t))
+    ((= ev-kind 0)
+     (cond
+       ((ev-space? ev-character) (ev-next))
+       ((= ev-character 59) (ev-comment))
+       ((= ev-character 39) (ev-next))
+       ((= ev-character 40)
+        (set! ev-kind 2) (set! ev-depth 1) (ev-next))
+       ((= ev-character 34)
+        (set! ev-kind 3) (set! ev-string #t) (ev-next))
+       (else (set! ev-kind 1) (ev-next))))
+    ((= ev-kind 1)
+     (if (or (ev-space? ev-character)
+             (= ev-character 40) (= ev-character 41)
+             (= ev-character 39) (= ev-character 59))
+         (set! ev-done #t)
+         (ev-next)))
+    (ev-in-comment
+     (if (= ev-character 10) (set! ev-in-comment #f))
+     (ev-next))
+    (ev-string
+     (cond
+       (ev-escape (set! ev-escape #f))
+       ((= ev-character 92) (set! ev-escape #t))
+       ((= ev-character 34)
+        (set! ev-string #f)
+        (if (= ev-kind 3) (set! ev-done #t))))
+     (ev-next))
+    (else
+      (cond
+        ((= ev-character 59) (set! ev-in-comment #t))
+        ((= ev-character 34) (set! ev-string #t))
+        ((= ev-character 40) (set! ev-depth (+ ev-depth 1)))
+        ((= ev-character 41)
+         (set! ev-depth (- ev-depth 1))
+         (if (= ev-depth 0) (set! ev-done #t))))
+      (ev-next))))

+; stack used to traverse a long source form or seek to its byte-independent
+; character offset.

+  (if (not ev-done)
+      (if (= count 1)
+          (ev-scan-step)
+          (begin
+            (ev-scan-batch (/ count 2))
+            (ev-scan-batch (/ count 2))))))
+
+(define (ev-scan)
+  (ev-scan-batch 64)
+  (if (not ev-done) (ev-scan)))
+
+(define (ev-seek port count)
+  (if (> count 0)
+      (if (= count 1)
+          (fgetchr port)
+          (let ((half (/ count 2)))
+            (ev-seek port half)
+            (ev-seek port (- count half))))))
+
+(define (ev-load env)
+  (ev-skip)
+  (if (not (= ev-character -1))
+      (begin
+        (if (< ev-line ev-parser-line)
+            (begin
+              (fclose ev-parser)
+              (set! ev-parser (fopen ev-name "r"))
+              (ev-seek ev-parser ev-offset)))
+        (let ((expression (fread ev-parser)))
+          (set! ev-kind 0)
+          (set! ev-depth 0)
+          (set! ev-string #f)
+          (set! ev-escape #f)
+          (set! ev-in-comment #f)
+          (set! ev-done #f)
+          (ev-scan)
+          (set! ev-parser-line (+ ev-line 1))
+          (ev-eval expression env)
+          (if ev-running (ev-load env))))))
+
+(if ev-source
+    (begin
+      (set! ev-character (fgetchr ev-source))
+      (ev-load (ev-globals))
+      (fclose ev-source)
+      (fclose ev-parser)))

+"""Public-entrypoint checks for the metacircular evaluator.
+
+Run with python3 -m unittest test_eval.
+"""
+
+import pathlib
+import subprocess
+import sys
+import tempfile
+import unittest
+
+
+ROOT = pathlib.Path(__file__).resolve().parent
+
+
+def run_scheme(program, data, cwd):
+    result = subprocess.run(
+        [sys.executable, str(ROOT / "interp.py"), str(program)],
+        input=data,
+        text=True,
+        stdout=subprocess.PIPE,
+        stderr=subprocess.PIPE,
+        cwd=cwd,
+        timeout=120,
+    )
+    if result.returncode or result.stderr:
+        raise AssertionError((result.returncode, result.stdout, result.stderr))
+    return result.stdout
+
+
+class EvaluatorTests(unittest.TestCase):
+    def test_calculator_and_self_interpretation(self):
+        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as cwd:
+            for depth in (0, 1, 2):
+                with self.subTest(depth=depth):
+                    paths = [str(ROOT / "eval.scm")] * depth
+                    paths.append(str(ROOT / "test/calculator.scm"))
+                    self.assertEqual(
+                        run_scheme(paths[0], "\n".join(paths[1:] + ["(+ 7 8)", ""]), cwd),
+                        "Reading\n15\nDone\n",
+                    )
+
+    def test_source_forms(self):
+        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as cwd:
+            source = pathlib.Path(cwd) / "forms.scm"
+            source.write_text(
+                "(); An empty form is not end-of-file.\n"
+                "(define x 7) (display (+ x 8))(newline)\n"
+                "'(ignored) 'atom #f 123\n"
+                "(display \"a; (b) \\\"quoted\\\"\")(newline)\n"
+                "(display (if 0 'truthy 'false))(newline)",
+                encoding="utf-8",
+            )
+            expected = run_scheme(source, "", cwd)
+            self.assertNotIn("Error", expected)
+            self.assertEqual(
+                run_scheme(ROOT / "eval.scm", str(source) + "\n", cwd), expected
+            )
+
+    def test_test_programs(self):
+        inputs = {
+            "06-interactive-io.scm": "7\n8\n+\n",
+            "calculator.scm": "(+ 7 8)\n",
+            "test_read.scm": "(hello 42)\n",
+        }
+        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as cwd:
+            for source in sorted((ROOT / "test").glob("*.scm")):
+                with self.subTest(program=source.name):
+                    data = inputs.get(source.name, "")
+                    expected = run_scheme(source, data, cwd)
+                    self.assertNotIn("Error", expected)
+                    self.assertNotIn("Unexpected error", expected)
+                    self.assertEqual(
+                        run_scheme(ROOT / "eval.scm", str(source) + "\n" + data, cwd),
+                        expected,
+                    )
+                    if source.name == "10-advanced-features.scm":
+                        self.assertEqual(
+                            (pathlib.Path(cwd) / "callback-test.txt").read_text(),
+                            "Written with callback!\n",
+                        )
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    unittest.main()

+;; Read one path line, then leave stdin and stdout to the interpreted program.
+;; Procedures accept a single list of arguments, including primitive procedures.
+;; A frame is a mutable binding list paired with its lexical parent.
+
+(define ev-tail-tag (cons #f #f))
+
+(define (ev-tail expression env)
+  (cons ev-tail-tag (cons expression env)))
+
+(define (ev-find name bindings)
+  (cond ((null? bindings) #f)
+        ((eq? name (car (car bindings))) (car bindings))
+        (else (ev-find name (cdr bindings)))))
+
+(define (ev-lookup name env)
+  (if (null? env)
+      undefined-variable
+      (let ((binding (ev-find name (car env))))
+        (if binding (cdr binding) (ev-lookup name (cdr env))))))
+
+(define (ev-define name value env)
+  (let ((binding (ev-find name (car env))))
+    (if binding
+        (set-cdr! binding value)
+        (set-car! env (cons (cons name value) (car env))))))
+
+(define (ev-set name value env)
+  (if (null? env)
+      undefined-variable
+      (let ((binding (ev-find name (car env))))
+        (if binding
+            (set-cdr! binding value)
+            (ev-set name value (cdr env))))))

+  (if (null? params)
+      (if (null? args) env arity-mismatch)
+      (if (null? args)
+          arity-mismatch
+          (begin
+            (ev-define (car params) (car args) env)
+            (ev-bind (cdr params) (cdr args) env)))))
+
+(define (ev-sequence body env)
+  (if (null? body)
+      '()
+      (if (null? (cdr body))
+          (ev-tail (car body) env)
+          (begin
+            (ev-eval (car body) env)
+            (ev-sequence (cdr body) env)))))

+(define (ev-procedure params body env)
+  (lambda (args)
+    (ev-sequence body (ev-bind params args (cons '() env)))))

+        (ev-let-bindings (cdr bindings) outer inner))))

+                (ev-cond (cdr clauses) env))))))

+                    interpreted.mkdir()

+                    expected = self.run_scheme(program, input_text, direct)

+                    self.assertNotIn('Error:', actual)

+                         for p in direct.rglob('*') if p.is_file()},
+                        {p.relative_to(interpreted): p.read_bytes()
+                         for p in interpreted.rglob('*') if p.is_file()},
+                    )

+    def test_calculator_and_self_interpretation(self):

+        for depth in range(3):

+                path = ROOT / ('test/calculator.scm' if depth == 0 else 'eval.scm')

+"""Compare the metacircular evaluator with the public Python entry point."""
+
+from pathlib import Path
+import subprocess
+import sys
+import tempfile
+import unittest
+
+
+ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
+

+def run_program(path, data="", depth=0, cwd=ROOT, timeout=180):
+    for _ in range(depth):
+        data = str(path) + "\n" + data
+        path = ROOT / "eval.scm"
+    result = subprocess.run(
+        [sys.executable, str(ROOT / "interp.py"), str(path)],
+        input=data,
+        text=True,
+        capture_output=True,
+        cwd=cwd,
+        timeout=timeout,
+    )
+    if result.returncode or result.stderr:
+        raise AssertionError(f"Interpreter failed: {result.stderr}")
+    return result.stdout

+        expected = "Reading\n15\nDone\n"
+        for depth in range(3):
+            with self.subTest(depth=depth):
+                self.assertEqual(
+                    run_program(ROOT / "test/calculator.scm", "(+ 7 8)\n", depth),
+                    expected,
+                )
+

+(define x 3) (display "(;)") (newline)
+() (define empty '()) (display empty) (newline)
+(define (make n) (lambda (x) (set! n (+ n x)) n))
+(define f (make 4)) (display (f 2)) (display (f 3)) (newline)
+(display (let ((x 8) (y x)) (+ x y))) (newline)
+(display (if 0 11 12)) (display (if '() 13 14)) (newline)
+(display (+)) (display (*)) (display (+ 1 2 3 4)) (newline)
+(display (and 0 #t)) (display (or '() #f)) (newline)
+(display '(hello "world" #t #f ())) (newline)
+(display (eq? "same" "same")) (newline)
+(define p (cons 1 2)) (set-car! p 5) (set-cdr! p 6)
+(display p) (newline) (display (pair? "text")) (newline)
+(display (number? #t)) (display (symbol? (chr 65))) (newline)
+(display (read)) (newline) (display (getchr)) (newline)
+(define output (fopen "data.scm" "w"))
+(fdisplay output "(display 42)\\n") (fputchr output 10) (fclose output)
+(define input (fopen "data.scm" "r"))
+(display (fread input)) (newline) (fclose input)
+(display (fread input)) (newline)
+(display (fdisplay input "closed")) (newline)
+'''
+        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as directory:
